mount.title: Mount Read-Only Image
mount.description: Choose a logical partition drive or complete physical-disk presentation. Both paths are read-only and never write original evidence.
mount.emulationDescription: Boot the image through an application-managed copy-on-write layer. Original evidence remains read-only and guest writes stay in the session overlay.
mount.sourceHint: The backend validates source state, evidence identity, and the partition catalog before mounting.
mount.partitionHint: Each mount binds to one partition; partitions are never concatenated.
mount.physicalDescription: The complete E01/raw image is presented to Windows through an iSCSI target bound only to loopback. Windows discovers the partition table and native volumes; no individual partition is selected.
mount.emulationSourceHint: Emulation binds the complete E01/raw source and isolates every guest write in a sparse COW overlay under the case directory.
mount.mountPointHint: The logical drive is published through Windows Mount Manager; the backend returns the final drive letter visible to standard Explorer.
mount.physicalTargetHint: Microsoft iSCSI Initiator creates a temporary non-persistent session. Meow~Detective runs as administrator and starts MSiSCSI when needed. If the service was disabled, its startup type is restored after the last physical mount is released. Windows assigns drive letters to recognized volumes according to system policy, and unmount removes the entire disk.
mount.recoveryIsoPlaceholder: Not selected; direct system boot requires confirmation
mount.recoveryIsoHint: A selected PE ISO always has the highest boot priority. Without trusted PE media, direct system boot requires another confirmation.
mount.directBootConfirm:
No trusted WinPE boot media is selected.

Continuing will boot the operating system inside the image. All disk writes remain in the case COW overlay and cannot modify original evidence. Continue?
mount.cowDescription: The guest may write during emulation, but every change stays in the current case's sparse overlay. Shut down the virtual machine before releasing the session.
mount.readOnlyDescription: Only reads, directory enumeration, and metadata queries are allowed. Create, write, delete, rename, and metadata changes are rejected.
mount.noSources: No data sources are available in the current case.

preflight.title: Image preflight (from import index)
preflight.xfsLogDirtyHint: An unreplayed XFS log was detected. Keep the pre-launch host repair enabled; disabling it may send the installed system into rescue mode.
preflight.xfsLogUnverifiedHint: At least one XFS log could not be verified. Pre-launch repair will assess it again and block launch when it cannot be handled safely.
preflight.ext4JournalDirtyHint: An ext4 journal still contains transactions the guest would replay. Pre-launch repair replays committed records and checkpoints the journal in the COW overlay before the password bypass.
preflight.ext4JournalUnverifiedHint: At least one ext4 journal could not be verified. Pre-launch repair will assess it again and block launch when it cannot be handled safely.
preflight.customServiceRestartHint: An enabled locally defined systemd service is configured to restart continuously. Missing dependencies or guest-incompatible scripts can make the console repeat stop/start messages; this is not evidence of XFS corruption.
preflight.remoteSessionGuardHint: A custom image script checks pts sessions and schedules forced termination. The emulation network is disabled by default, but the behavior remains an image-side finding.
preflight.linuxBypassHint: Select an account under Logon bypass. Before launch, its password is set to 123456 in the COW overlay without modifying the original evidence.
preflight.osdataNonEmptyHint: OSDATA is not empty; use the PE route
